docx_locations.text: Beginning from two premises — (1) the observable universe exists inside a Schwarzschild black hole, and (2) the physics inside the horizon is the same as outside — this paper resolves the V-vs-V’ class-membership problem: whether the weak-sector BBN dressing coefficient reads V(α) = K_gauge = ln(1+γ²) (the finite modular generator) or V’(α) = 2γ (the tangent covector). Conditional on three physical identification premises (H1–H3), the paper proves V = K_gauge exactly. This resolves the WMR premise (Paper 22) and corrects the weak amplitude from √L_1 to L_1. The remaining conditional premises (GMP, TBS, cluster deformation, PSRP, boundary covariance exponent) are unaffected.

This result corrects Paper 22’s weak amplitude from ε_w = K_gauge × √L_1 to ε_w = K_gauge × L_1. The correction improves the BBN fit: PRyMordial-verified results give D/H = −0.61σ, Y_p = +0.68σ, Li-7/H = +0.55σ, with χ² = 1.13 (versus 2.11 for the uncorrected linear branch). All three primordial abundances are within 1σ of observation with zero fitted parameters.

The Interior Observer (IO) framework models the observable universe as the interior of a Schwarzschild black hole with mass M_U = 4.50 × 10⁵³ kg. Papers 1–24 derived all major cosmological observables from this single measured input plus one external parameter (γ_BI = 0.2375 from Loop Quantum Gravity) and three physical principles: the Conformal Modular Principle (CMP), the Baryon Dictionary Principle (BDP), and the Gauge Thermal Transfer Principle (GTTP), all upgraded to DERIVED/THEOREM status by Paper 18.
5. The quadratic weak branch ε_w = K_gauge × L_1 gives χ² = 1.13 with all three BBN observables within 1σ. PRyMordial-VERIFIED.
The quadratic weak branch ε_w = K_gauge × L_1 = 0.012301 gives χ² = 1.13, improving on the linear branch’s χ² = 2.11.
Exact BBN computation using PRyMordial with the Paper 24 v1.1 lithium pipeline:

The quadratic weak branch achieves all three primordial abundances within 1σ of observation with zero fitted parameters. The combined three-observable χ² drops from 2.11 to 1.13 — a 46% improvement. V’ is excluded at 12σ+ against direct measurements.
NEW: ε_w = K_gauge × L_1 = 0.012301

Paper 22’s structural results (GMP, channel placement, bridge mechanics, spatial Hodge spectrum) are unchanged. Only the weak amplitude formula and its derivation status are corrected. Papers 23 and 24 are unaffected: Paper 23’s bridge is correctly linear in δA (the bridge IS linear; the rate squares it), and Paper 24’s lithium mechanism operates entirely through the nuclear j=2 channel.
Step 1: Schwarzschild radius (Paper 1 §2.1). r_s = 2GM_U/c² = 6.685 × 10²⁶ m. The observable universe sits within a factor 1.5 of its own Schwarzschild radius. STATUS: DERIVED (standard GR, exact)

Step 5: Compactness ratio (Paper 1 §2.1). x = r_s/R_U = 1.51899. The Schwarzschild radius exceeds the observable universe radius by a factor of 1.519, placing the observer deep inside the horizon at 65.8% of the Schwarzschild radius. This single dimensionless ratio, together with γ_BI, determines all framework observables. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 15: No-Go for semiclassical QFT (Paper 2 §3). Semiclassical QFT on stationary Schwarzschild CANNOT produce T_IO. Five candidate mechanisms examined and excluded (Bogoliubov coefficient analysis, 36/36 verification checks). The 30-order gap requires quantum gravitational physics. STATUS: DERIVED (theorem)
Step 33: Complete BBN scorecard: D/H at −1.2σ, Y_p at +0.6σ — DERIVED (conditional on BDP) [Paper 19: α=3/2 clustering branch gives ω_b = 0.01705; BOSS DR12 χ² = 73.06]

Step 37: V-hierarchy (Papers 9–13). Complete algebraic hierarchy of the generating potential: exp(V) = 1+γ² = 1.0564 (Paper 9), V′′ = 2(1+γ²) = 2.1128 (Paper 10), V′ = 2γ = 0.4750 (Paper 12), V = K_gauge = 0.05487 (Paper 13). Each derivative encodes a distinct physical observable: V seeds the spectral norm, V′ the baryon fraction, V′′ the curvature, and exp(V) the amplification. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 49: Interior/exterior asymmetry (Paper 14). Observable corrections are interior projection effects arising from Premise 1 (observer inside a Schwarzschild BH). The no-hair theorem (standard GR) blocks exterior access to R_U,int. Cross-cancellation of x_ext and x_int is blocked because the exterior observer has no access to the interior compactness ratio. This follows directly from Premise 1 + standard GR. STATUS: DERIVED
A.1.13 Paper 14 New Results: Kill Shot C (H₀ Composite)

Step 67: Boundary No-Go (Paper 15). Local Schwarzschild horizon scalars are x-independent: they depend only on r_s, not on the ratio r_s/R_U. Therefore local horizon quantities cannot distinguish the observer’s position inside the black hole. Any observable correction must arise from global or topological structure, not local curvature invariants. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 92: Foundation closure. All three High gaps closed within the reduced Schwarzschild tangential thermal sector. Scope: reduced sector used by Papers 14–17, not full unreduced horizon algebra. STATUS: DERIVED (reduced sector)

Step 95: CMP Modular Realization Theorem (Theorem 18.C). K_CMP = K_geom · I + K̂_g. On physical sector: ⟨K⟩ = K_geom + K_gauge = ln Δ. Additive decomposition from tensor product structure, no BCH correction. Numeric check: K_geom + K_gauge − ln Δ = 0 to machine precision. STATUS: DERIVED/THEOREM (conditional on C1–C5)

Step 99: BDP Modular Derivation Theorem (Theorem 18.B). f_b = x⁻¹ · V′(α) = 2γ/x = 0.3127. Master identity f_b × F = ⟨K⟩/4 follows downstream. Numeric check: f_b × F − ⟨K⟩/4 = 0 to machine precision. STATUS: DERIVED/THEOREM (conditional on B1–B5)
Step 115: P(k) crisis diagnosis. Paper 18 P(k) catastrophe (chi-squared = 1056) was misdiagnosed as N_eff-driven. Paper 19 proves the dominant driver is the baryon mapping. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 116: Baryon Scalarization Theorem. Observable-class Jacobian: omega_b(O) = omega_b(alpha=1) x^(1-alpha_O). For P(k) clustering: alpha = 3/2, omega_b = 0.01705. Three bridge theorems, two surgical repairs. BOSS DR12 chi-squared = 73.06 on 84 points. STATUS: DERIVED/THEOREM (Wolfram validated, S1-S6)

Step 118: Architectural shift (Paper 18). Project the Hamiltonian constraint, not the fluid. The correct IO approach projects the gravitational constraint equation onto the observer sector, rather than projecting individual fluid components. This shift resolves the universal-projector failure. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 121: RT upgrade chain (Paper 19 §3). The complete derivation chain for the reduced-scope temperature transfer: Premise 1 (Schwarzschild interior) → isolated-horizon certification → RT/BY boundary framework → Ashtekar-Barbero connection → Paper 16 gauge-projection theorems P1–P6 → CMP lapse factor. Each link is theorem-grade within its scope. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 128: Schur N-slot dissolution and bare background tension. Observer-side curvature projector dissolved by global readout. Curvature rank n=0 confirmed. Bare dissolution branch gives 15.07 Gyr (6.3 sigma too old). N_mode = 0.336 still required for age closure. N-slot transformed from observer-side projector to upstream bare-background closure problem. Foundation item #2. STATUS: DERIVED
omega_b,clust = 0.01705 (alpha = 3/2); BOSS DR12 chi-squared = 73.06; sigma_8 = 0.794; S_8 = 0.839

Step 147: Bare expansion diagnostic (Paper 20 §7). Switching from the observer to the bare expansion history shifts D_A by +3.44% but shifts r_s by only −0.04%. The acoustic angular scale is dominated by r_s, not D_A. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 152: BBN multi-channel incompatibility (Paper 20 §9). D/H fails at −3.9σ with N_eff = 3.044 (standard model). The D/H tension identifies a required radiation excess ΔN_eff ≈ 0.37. This excess cannot come from any single mechanism tested in Paper 20. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 153: BBN measurement immunity (Paper 20 §11). Abundance ratios (D/H, Y_p, ⁷Li/H) are dimensionless. Both species share the same astrophysical geometry. Any boundary geometric correction cancels in the ratio. Observable-class Jacobians cannot apply to nuclear reactions: nuclei are not observers, and different α for different reactions violates Premise 2. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 165: ΔN_eff target (Paper 20 §14). ΔN_eff ≈ 0.37 required to match D/H observation. Three premises needed (P_fullgrav, P_puncham, P_radmap) not yet in theorem stack. F_abs = 0.36879 derived as the absolute local Casimir load (Paper 21). STATUS: DERIVED

Step 179: Assembly gap decoupling (Theorem 21.C, Paper 21 §8.1). On the torsion-Λ homogeneous branch, d ln H₀_obs / d ln N_eff = 4.96×10⁻⁵. Achieving H₀_obs = 67.4 would require N_eff ≈ 6708. The assembly gap and D/H radiation deficit are completely decoupled problems. STATUS: DERIVED
Step 182: No dynamic scattering / Γ=1 / ΔN_eff=0 (Theorem 21.Bb). Full 3+1 mode-matching kernel open. STATUS: DERIVED/NO-GO (not yet theorem-grade bundled)
Step 191: BBN scorecard at N_eff = 3.4062 on T_IO branch. D/H = −0.08σ, Y_p = +1.72σ, χ² = 2.97. T_obs insertion gives χ² = 99.02 (class error). STATUS: DERIVED

Step 200: BBN scorecard at N_eff = 3.41279 on T_IO branch (Paper 21 §11). With F_abs route: D/H σ = +0.11 (was −3.916 at baseline), Y_p σ = +1.74, χ²(D/H + Y_p) = 2.97 (was 15.61 at baseline). The F_abs route substantially improves the BBN scorecard over the baseline N_eff = 3.044. STATUS: DERIVED
Step 205: Uniform rate suppression no-go (21.AG computational). D/H-matching s = 0.892 gives Y_p = +5.73σ. Wrong abundance pattern. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 214: P_resp Three-Channel Architecture (Reconstruction). Non-separable candidate: R_spatial(E,T) = Σ κ_{s,n,J} Π_{0,n,J} ⊗ P_J + Σ κ_{v,n,J} Π_{1,n,J}^coex ⊗ P_J + Σ κ_{t,n,J} Π_{TT,n,J} ⊗ P_J, with hard selection rule s ≤ J from Channel Floor Theorem. Joint-spectral in spatial channel and puncture spin. Satisfies all Paper 21 P_resp constraints (non-separable, channel-dependent, puncture-derived). The {j=1,2} energy-weighted decomposition: 0.3622 = 0.2242 (vector, j=1) + 0.1381 (tensor, j=2). Physical delivery kernels, energy-density entry mechanism, BBN-era constancy, and recombination-era reduction remain open. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 221: Bounded-Ratio No-Go (Theorem 22.11). c_K/c_Γ ~ Ha ~ a⁻¹ ∝ (1+z). At BBN ~ 10⁹, at recombination ~ 1100; both are large-argument. Any untuned bounded saturator stays on plateau at both epochs. Cannot create BBN-on / recombination-off gate without explicit threshold. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 222: Shutoff Localization Theorem (Theorem 22.12). From Theorems 22.8–22.11: epoch gate cannot live in Z_punc/F_abs/P_J (permanent), spatial projectors alone (stress scalarization), A-B connection monomials (trivial), or bounded ratio functions (saturated). Must live in bridge/response kernel or equivalent pre-C_bare assembly map. Observable map alone is too late. Scope: exclusion strong but not exhaustive — does not yet exclude time-dependent boundary states, nonlocal memory kernels, or other dimensionless invariants. STATUS: DERIVED (within tested classes)

Step 227: Full-Radiation Scaling Equivalence (Theorem 22.14). If ρ_r → (1+F_abs)ρ_r, then ΔN_eff,eq = [(1+β_rel N_eff,base)/β_rel] × F_abs = 2.746, so N_eff,eff = 5.790. This is NOT equivalent to ΔN_eff = F_abs. Catastrophic at both BBN (D/H = +25.6σ) and θ* (−10%). STATUS: DERIVED

Step 228: Single-Coefficient Radiation-Dressing No-Go (Theorem 22.15). No single scalar c_rad applied as ρ_r → (1+c_rad)ρ_r closes both D/H and θ* simultaneously. c_DH = 0.0495 breaks θ* by ~1.5%; c_θ = 0.0138 leaves D/H at −2.96σ. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 231: Response Matrix (Theorem 22.18). +1% freeze-out bump (0.7 MeV): Δ(D/H_σ, Y_p_σ) = (−0.106, +0.114). +1% nucleosynthesis bump (0.07 MeV): Δ(D/H_σ, Y_p_σ) = (+0.409, +0.060). Freeze-out is the helium lever; nucleosynthesis is the deuterium lever. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 233: Two-Window Near-Closure. Bimodal kernel ε_F = 0.076, ε_N = 0.067 gives D/H_σ = +0.096, Y_p_σ = +1.749, matching benchmark to 0.017σ/0.005σ. θ* safe at 1.93 × 10⁻⁷. Freeze-out lobe broad; nucleosynthesis lobe timing sharp. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 234: Weak-Nuclear Lever (Theorem 22.20). +1% weak-rate suppression: Δ(D/H_σ, Y_p_σ) = (+0.268, +0.454). +1% nuclear-network suppression: (+1.240, −0.011). Microphysical confirmation of two-lever structure. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 235: Full-Nuclear Near-Closure (Theorem 22.21). Weak suppression 0.012301 + nuclear suppression 0.023842 gives D/H_σ = −0.61, Y_p_σ = +1.06, target distance² = 0.99 from corrected benchmark. Kinetic-vs-Hubble Boundary: ρ_b/ρ_rad ~ 10⁻⁸ at 0.7 MeV, so H(z) backreaction negligible. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 238: Zero-Parameter Amplitude Construction (Theorem 22.23). ε_w = K_gauge × L_1 = 0.054873 × 0.22417 = 0.012301. ε_n = (⟨K⟩/10) × L_2 = (1.72704/10) × 0.13805 = 0.023842. K_gauge = ln(1+γ²) exact. 10 = mult_TT(n=2). All constants from established framework. PRyMordial: D/H_σ = −0.61, Y_p_σ = +1.06, χ² = 1.50, with substantially lower χ² than the two-parameter fitted comparator in the current PRyMordial setup (χ² = 3.067). Weak gap: 0%. Nuclear gap: 0% by construction. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 239: Li-7 Out-of-Sample Consistency (Theorem 22.24). Li7/H = 5.391 × 10⁻¹⁰ (+12.29σ), improving baseline by 4.5%, matching uniform benchmark to 0.07%. He-3 prediction: 3He/H = 1.051 × 10⁻⁵. Li-7 not used in calibration. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 241: Conditional Bridge Operator (Theorem 22.25). Under GMP + TBS (WMR resolved): P_resp^(bridge) = −K_gauge(R_w ⊗ I_n ⊗ Π_w ⊗ L_1 P_1) − (⟨K⟩/10)(I_w ⊗ R_n ⊗ Π_n ⊗ L_2 P_2). Active matrix elements: −0.012301 (weak), −0.023842 (nuclear). Sector selection from GMP + Channel Floor. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 266: Selection rule (Theorem 23.2, Paper 23 §3.2). Vector shell n feeds scalar shells N = n±1 only, from SU(2)_L × SU(2)_R Clebsch-Gordan decomposition. The scalar appears with multiplicity one in each relevant chiral product. Wolfram-validated with explicit tensor product verification. STATUS: DERIVED/THEOREM
A.1.30 Paper 24 New Results: Channel-Resolved BBN and the Lithium Problem

Step 311: BBN sensitivity table (Paper 24 §2). α_{D/H}(34) = α_{Y_p}(34) = 0 for ³He(α,γ)⁷Be (reaction 34). D/H and Y_p have zero sensitivity to the rate modification that resolves the lithium problem. The lithium channel is orthogonal to the other BBN observables. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 318: Ground-state branching (Paper 24 §6). f_gs = 0.711 from Br(0) = 0.406. The branching ratio to the ⁷Be ground state determines the partition of the total capture rate between ground-state and excited-state channels. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 320: Branch-sum formula (Paper 24 §8). R_34,tot = f_gs R_gs + (1−f_gs) R_ex. The total rate modification is the branching-weighted sum of ground-state and excited-state dressings. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 326: Combined lithium result (Paper 24 §8). R_34,tot = 0.326. Li-7/H = 1.75 × 10⁻¹⁰ (observed: 1.6 ± 0.3 × 10⁻¹⁰). Within 0.5σ of observation. Zero fitted parameters (conditional on cluster deformation premise). STATUS: DERIVED

Step 327: D/H and Y_p unchanged (Paper 24 §9). D/H at −0.61σ, Y_p at +0.68σ (PRyMordial). The lithium channel modification does not disturb the other BBN observables. Full scorecard χ² = 1.13 on three observables. STATUS: DERIVED
Step 332: Exit proton sensitivity (Paper 24 §10). B_p = 0.687 from Hayakawa 2021. d ln R/dδ computed for ⁷Li(p,α) destruction channel. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 333: ⁷Li(p,α) suppression (Paper 24 §10). TT dressing reduces the destruction rate, partially offsetting the production suppression. Net effect is still a strong reduction in Li-7 abundance. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 336: Stealth floor (Paper 24 §11). R_tot,min = 1 − f_gs = 0.289 in the static-only (no transition quadrupole) model. Even without the excited-state contribution, the lithium problem is substantially ameliorated. STATUS: DERIVED
Step 340: Final BBN scorecard (Paper 24 §11). D/H (−0.61σ), Y_p (+0.68σ), Li-7/H (+0.50σ). Combined χ² = 1.13 on three observables with zero fitted parameters. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 343: V⊕V weak-shell multiplicity (Paper 24 §12). E_w ≅ V⊕V from chiral decomposition of coexact 1-forms at n=1. Bridge selection rule forces only W₁⁺ to feed the scalar bridge B₀. Schur uniqueness on single V. STATUS: DERIVED

Step 347: Independent BBN cross-verification (Paper 24 §13). Full channel-resolved pipeline implemented in AlterBBN (Arbey et al. 2018). Code-to-code agreement with PRyMordial: D/H (0.3%), Y_p (0.7%), Li-7/H (0.4%). The lithium prediction is code-independent. STATUS: DERIVED
Step 369: PRyMordial verification of quadratic branch (Paper 25 §8). D/H = −0.61σ, Y_p = +0.68σ, Li-7/H = +0.55σ. Full BBN scorecard χ² = 1.13 with V = K_gauge (quadratic). STATUS: DERIVED
Step 378: PRyMordial V’ exclusion (Paper 25 §8). V’ branch gives χ² = 412.85 (catastrophic). V quadratic branch gives χ² = 1.13. V’ is excluded at overwhelming significance. STATUS: DERIVED
